description: Health, lag, throughput, and apply errors for bidirectional Oracle GoldenGate replication between West and East.

options.content: **West → East** is extract **EWEST** and replicat **RWEST** on trail `ew`. **East → West** is extract **EEAST** and replicat **REAST** on trail `ee`. Checkpoint lag is how far that process is behind the change it is reading. Heartbeat lag is end-to-end; heartbeats are written every 60 seconds. Discards, failed conflicts, and conversion errors should stay at zero.

panels.title: Process health
panels.description: One tile per process. Stopped; Stalled (running but not caught up, and its trail position has not moved for 2 minutes; lag metrics freeze in this state, so they look fine); Lagging (last operation more than 60 s behind); Processing; Caught up.

targets.query:
import "date"

running = from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "resource-status_running" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["resource-name"] =~ /${process:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["resource-name"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r["resource-name"], _field: "running", _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> group()
eof = from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "position-er_end-of-file" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["processName"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r.processName, _field: "eof", _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> group()
lag = from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "position-er_last-operation-lag" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["processName"])
  |> last()
  // GoldenGate reports this lag in nanoseconds; convert to seconds
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r.processName, _field: "lag", _value: float(v: r._value) / 1000000000.0}))
  |> group()

// Has the process advanced its trail position in the last 2 minutes? (replicats: read side, extracts: write side)
moved = from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r._measurement == "trail-input_trail-rba" and r.processType == "replicat") or (r._measurement == "trail-output_trail-rba" and r.processType == "extract"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value" and r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["processName"])
  |> spread()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({process: r.processName, _field: "moved", _value: if r._value > 0 then 1.0 else 0.0}))
  |> group()

// 0 stopped, 1 stalled (not caught up, position frozen 2 min), 2 lagging (> 60 s behind), 3 processing, 4 caught up
union(tables: [running, eof, lag, moved])
  |> group(columns: ["process"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["process"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: v.timeRangeStop,
      process: r.process,
      _value: if not exists r.running or r.running < 0.5 then 0.0
              else if exists r.eof and r.eof < 0.5 and exists r.moved and r.moved < 0.5 then 1.0
              else if exists r.lag and r.lag > 60.0 then 2.0
              else if exists r.eof and r.eof < 0.5 then 3.0
              else 4.0,
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["process"])

panels.title: Row collisions
panels.description: Replicat rows that already existed on insert/update/delete, or were missing on update/delete (cumulative).

targets.query:
summed = (measurement) =>
  from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == measurement and r._field == "value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
    |> group(columns: ["processName"])
    |> last()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({processName: r.processName, _value: float(v: r._value), _field: "collisions"}))

union(tables: [
  summed(measurement: "statistics-replicat_total-insert-row-exists"),
  summed(measurement: "statistics-replicat_total-update-row-missing"),
  summed(measurement: "statistics-replicat_total-delete-row-missing"),
  summed(measurement: "statistics-replicat_total-update-row-exists"),
  summed(measurement: "statistics-replicat_total-delete-row-exists"),
])
  |> group(columns: ["processName"])
  |> sum()

panels.title: Trail throughput
panels.description: Bytes per second written by the extracts and read by the replicats. Read rate stuck at zero while the extract is writing means the replicat is not consuming the trail.

targets.query:

from(bucket: "goldengate-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trail-output_io-write-bytes" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /^(EWEST|EEAST)$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
  |> group(columns: ["processName"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "trail write"})),

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.processName =~ /${process:regex}/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "processName"])
  |> group(columns: ["processName"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "trail read"}))
])
